as_told.title: Engineered material extracted from within the mesa

plain: Something large and metallic is said to be buried deep inside a mesa, a flat-topped hill, at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange reports. Michels tells it on two episodes. In one, he says a scientific team used soil resistivity and ground-penetrating radar, both ways of looking underground without digging, and found a big metal object about 400 feet below the mesa, crediting the work to people named Aaron Blunt and Ravi Chandran. In another, he says such objects have been located but are hard to pull out, "like they have a life of their own," and points to Secrets of Skinwalker Ranch, a television series about the property. The ranch's owner, speaking firsthand on an episode where he breaks his silence, tells it differently. He says engineered, manufactured material has in fact been extracted "from hundreds of feet within the mesa." If it were true, it would mean something made by someone was placed deep underground long ago.
